items.title: 66095_Benny Carter oral history interview
items.q: Trumbauer Frankie Tromburg played, and it was the instrument that was on sale at this pawn shop

ctx.x: Well, I didn't think of it as being important at the time, other than it was the instrument that
Trumbauer Frankie Tromburg played, and it was the instrument that was on sale at this pawn shop where they, you know, where they would trade me for the trumpet that I couldn't play over the weekend.
Uh huh. But these early lessons, then, would have been just concerned with just the fundamentals of the instrument; that is, the production of sound.
